pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto bhātuno saddhivihārikaṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.6: eh' āvuso, ahan te cīvaraṃ dassāmīti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.10: atha kho tassa bhikkhuno etad ahosi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.11: na dān' āhaṃ āyasmatā Upanandena Sakyaputtena saddhiṃ janapadacārikaṃ pakkamissāmi, bhagavatā saddhiṃ janapadacārikaṃ pakkamissāmīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.12: atha kho āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.14: nāhaṃ bhante tayā saddhiṃ janapadacārikaṃ pakkamissāmi, bhagavatā saddhiṃ janapadacārikaṃ pakkamissāmīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.15: yaṃ pi ty āhaṃ āvuso cīvaraṃ adāsiṃ mayā saddhiṃ janapadacārikaṃ pakkamissatīti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.17: atha kho so bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.18: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.19: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā Upanando Sakyaputto bhikkhussa sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindissatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.20: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.21: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ Upananda bhikkhussa sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.24: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa bhikkhussa sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.25: n' etaṃ moghapurisa appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--;
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.26: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:1.27.1: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindeyya vā acchindāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:2.17: sakiṃ āṇatto bahukaṃ pi acchindati, nissaggiyaṃ hoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:2.21: idaṃ me bhante cīvaraṃ bhikkhussa sāmaṃ datvā acchinnaṃ nissaggiyaṃ, imāhaṃ saṃghassa nissajjāmīti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:2.25.1: upasampanne upasampannasaññī cīvaraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:2.26: upasampanne vematiko cīvaraṃ . . . acchindāpeti vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:2.27: upasampanne anupasampannasaññī cīvaraṃ . . . acchindāpeti vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:2.28: aññaṃ parikkhāraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np25:2.29: anupasampannassa cīvaraṃ vā aññaṃ vā parikkhāraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindati vā acchindāpeti vā, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
